params.trailing_logic: Moves SL to indicator value only if it tightens the stop (closer to current price). For BUY: NewStop must be > LastStop. For SELL: NewStop must be < LastStop. Initial placement uses MathMin/MathMax of last 2 bars.

other_exits: EA does not open positions - it only manages stop-loss trailing on existing positions. It requires a position to already be open before any modification occurs.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: This EA does not open positions at all - it only modifies SL of existing positions. No position sizing logic exists.

custom_logic_notes: This is NOT a standalone trading EA - it is a trailing stop manager. It never opens positions. It only modifies the stop-loss of an existing open position based on the CandleStop custom indicator values. Key logic: (1) When position has NO SL (LastStop==0), it sets initial SL using the more conservative of last 2 indicator bar values (MathMax of UpValue for sells, MathMin of DnValue for buys). (2) When position already HAS an SL, it trails only on new bars, moving SL to indicator[0] value only if it tightens the stop (BUY: new SL must be > old SL; SELL: new SL must be < old SL). (3) Uses StopCorrect() to enforce broker minimum stop level distance. (4) The Recount flag forces recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. (5) Position is selected by Symbol() which means it works only on same-symbol positions (no multi-symbol support). (6) The dBuyPositionModify and dSellPositionModify functions have a guard: they won't move SL away from price (only tighten), and they won't send modification if SL/TP haven't changed.
python_conversion_notes: This EA requires the CandleStop custom indicator to be reimplemented in Python. The indicator is loaded via iCustom with 3 params (UpTrailPeriods, DnTrailPeriods, 0) and uses buffers 1 (UpValue/trailing high stop) and 2 (DnValue/trailing low stop). Buffer 0 is not used. The trailing logic itself is straightforward: only tighten stops, never loosen them. The main challenge is replicating the CandleStop indicator which appears to be a chandelier-like exit based on highest high / lowest low over N periods. The Charts\Chart.mqh include is only for chart display (IndicatorAdd) and can be omitted in Python. The StopCorrect function enforces SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL minimum distance which must be handled in Python by querying the symbol info. Position modification uses TRADE_ACTION_SLTP which is straightforward to replicate via MT5 Python API. The CIsNewBar class detects new bars by comparing SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE - simple to replicate. Note: The EA uses PositionSelect(Symbol()) which is netting/hedging dependent - in Python, position selection should match the MT5 account mode.
